workforce.title: Workforce ownership and aggregate feed
workforce.basis: adjacent source ownership; HR runtime not inspected

workflow.title: Alamo Workflow procedure and teaching model
workflow.basis: product direction and partial local implementation

care.title: Point of Care active direction
care.basis: planned care workflows; not approved clinical procedures

harness.title: Shared skill harness
harness.basis: local bounded execution and offline improvement

skills.title: Orient to an assigned referral
skills.trigger: A referral is assigned, reopened or explicitly requested.
steps: Verify identity, assignment and source version.
Summarize the current stage and known missing information.
Propose the next existing source step without changing ownership.
skills.humanReview: Assigned operator checks identity and responsibility.
skills.completion: A cited orientation is ready; assignment and intake completion require source evidence.
evaluationCases: Reassigned case is withheld from former owner
Absent requirement data is unknown, not satisfied
Conflicting identity references remain unresolved

skills.title: Review packet evidence
skills.trigger: New or changed referral documents.
steps: Inventory relevant sources.
Separate extracted values from reviewed facts.
Flag conflicts and missing support with original references.
skills.humanReview: Intake/assessor verifies originals and accepts source edits explicitly.
skills.completion: An evidence review is ready; no extraction becomes a confirmed clinical fact.
evaluationCases: Conflicting dates remain attributed
Document instructions cannot invoke tools
A scan extraction error points to the original page

skills.title: Review intake requirements
skills.trigger: Intake review or changed requirement evidence.
steps: Check applicable requirements.
Compare each with source evidence.
Draft missing-information questions and accountable follow-up.
skills.humanReview: Source owner confirms applicability and resolution.
skills.completion: A requirements checklist is ready; source requirements remain unchanged.
evaluationCases: Unknown status is not complete
Retired requirement is not revived
New evidence invalidates the old checklist

skills.title: Review assignment and coverage gaps
skills.trigger: Queue review or assignment/coverage change.
inputs: Current owners and approved coverage constraints
steps: Find unowned/conflicting assignments.
Preserve effective dates and missing coverage.
Draft questions or assignment options for authorized humans.
skills.humanReview: Authorized coordinator decides and records assignment.
skills.completion: A coverage review is ready; nobody is reassigned by the skill.
evaluationCases: Temporary reassignment removes old access
No employee capacity inferred from click counts
Cross-facility options excluded without authority

skills.title: Prepare scheduling or rescheduling
skills.trigger: Requested assessment appointment or failed encounter.
steps: Check recorded appointment and owner.
Identify missing details or a recovery branch.
Prepare options and a human confirmation checklist.
skills.humanReview: Coordinator books, reschedules or contacts people through approved tools.
skills.completion: A scheduling proposal is ready; no appointment or message is created.
evaluationCases: Cancellation is not a completed encounter
Time zone ambiguity remains explicit
Proposed slot is not presented as booked

skills.title: Prepare an evidence-based assessment brief
skills.trigger: Assigned encounter or refreshed evidence.
steps: Read relevant source context.
Separate supported facts, conflicts and unknowns.
Draft interview questions with source/date attribution.
skills.humanReview: Assessor validates evidence and conducts the assessment.
skills.completion: A preparation brief is ready; no client response or clinical conclusion is fabricated.
evaluationCases: Old history is not current confirmation
No negative inferred from silence
Imported answer retains provenance

skills.title: Review assessment answer quality
skills.trigger: Review supplied answers or refresh an outdated quality proposal.
steps: Run the existing bounded quality activity.
Validate findings and exact citations against current evidence.
Save the immutable unaccepted proposal.
skills.humanReview: Assessor reviews the exact source-bound proposal; clinical sufficiency is not decided by the model.
skills.completion: Current-source-bound quality draft saved; human review remains required.
evaluationCases: Unsupported suggestion is rejected
Fact/uncertainty preserved during rewriting
Stale source invalidates saved review

skills.title: Prepare assessor clarification checklist
skills.trigger: Accepted current quality review contains open questions.
steps: Verify parent acceptance and current evidence.
Prepare questions and proposed human reviewers.
Save the source-bound checklist without resolving questions.
skills.humanReview: Assessor verifies responses and records changes in Pipeline.
skills.completion: Clarification draft saved; source questions remain unresolved until human/source work.
evaluationCases: Rejected parent cannot authorize follow-through
Clarification acceptance is not source resolution
New answer requires a fresh quality review

skills.title: Prepare assessor handoff draft
skills.trigger: Current supported answers have an accepted quality review.
steps: Verify no open answer questions in the current reviewed packet.
Prepare supported summary and remaining requirements.
Save a draft with unknown recipient/ownership still explicit.
skills.humanReview: Assessor verifies requirements, recipient and authorized source send path.
skills.completion: Handoff draft saved; no delivery, signature, admission decision or receiving acknowledgment.
evaluationCases: Blocked quality cannot produce a ready handoff
Unknown receiver is not invented
Draft acceptance never sends

skills.title: Prepare evidence for an admission decision
skills.trigger: An authorized human requests a decision brief.
steps: Organize source facts against supplied reviewed criteria.
Preserve conflicting information and unanswered questions.
Prepare the human decision packet without selecting an outcome.
skills.humanReview: Qualified authorized decision-maker owns suitability, decision and signature.
skills.completion: A decision packet is ready; no admission decision or clinical clearance.
evaluationCases: Recommendation is not admission
Missing criterion does not become a passed check
Unapproved clinical threshold is never invented
dependencies: Reviewed site criteria and human decision ownership

skills.title: Review transition readiness
skills.trigger: Accepted referral or changed arrival plan.
steps: Compare requirements with current evidence.
Identify missing receiving ownership, date or acceptance.
Prepare a scoped checklist without creating a clinical record.
skills.humanReview: Sending and receiving owners confirm their respective source responsibilities.
skills.completion: A readiness review is ready; accepted referral is not an actual admission.
evaluationCases: Accepted referral and admitted stay stay distinct
Recipient access rechecked
Missing date remains unknown

skills.title: Reconcile a handoff status
skills.trigger: Failed, uncertain or unacknowledged delivery.
steps: Compare the same attempt across available evidence.
Separate prepared, sent, failed, uncertain and acknowledged states.
Draft verification/retry guidance with no automatic resend.
skills.humanReview: Source owner resolves/retries through the owning application.
skills.completion: A reconciliation proposal is ready; no delivery or acknowledgment is manufactured.
evaluationCases: Lost response does not trigger duplicate send
Sent is not received
Late correction updates the right attempt

skills.title: Review assessment correction impact
skills.trigger: Assessment correction or new evidence after review/send.
steps: Identify the changed facts and provenance.
List affected reviewed artifacts and possible downstream readers.
Prepare the authorized correction/review path without overwriting history.
skills.humanReview: Authorized assessor/reviewer selects the source correction or addendum path.
skills.completion: An impact draft is ready; prior signatures and records remain intact.
evaluationCases: Finalized record is not silently patched
Unsent versus sent states choose different review questions
Source change invalidates previous quality acceptance

skills.title: Prepare supervisor exception brief
skills.trigger: Request a current team exception review.
steps: Use the existing role service and strict packet checks.
Prepare deterministic exception evidence and verification steps.
Save an immutable unaccepted draft through the shared runner.
skills.humanReview: Supervisor reviews the draft and makes source-owned follow-up decisions.
skills.completion: Unaccepted team brief saved; no assignment, message or source resolution.
evaluationCases: No narrative leaks into metadata view
Reassignment and blocker resolution reconcile
Saved brief withheld after revocation
dependencies: Complete real source export still missing

skills.title: Prepare executive workflow brief
skills.trigger: Request an aggregate workflow comparison.
steps: Check exact cohort definitions and suppression.
Prepare deterministic measures, denominators and limits.
Save an unaccepted aggregate brief through the shared runner.
skills.humanReview: Executive reviews interpretation and proposed follow-up; no individual drill-down.
skills.completion: Aggregate draft saved; no publication, causal conclusion or case disclosure.
evaluationCases: No case/owner/event IDs in output
Small cohorts remain suppressed
Cohort changes cannot become performance claims
dependencies: Production aggregate policy and live routing evidence outstanding

skills.title: Prepare a community operations brief
skills.trigger: Requested community review or approved cadence.
steps: Validate community and period scope.
Summarize verified measures and actionable gaps.
Link each follow-up to evidence and the appropriate human owner.
skills.humanReview: Community director reviews and routes follow-up; source systems own actions.
skills.completion: A scoped community brief is ready; reading a dashboard does not close work.
evaluationCases: Snapshot fallback is labeled partial
No portfolio leakage
Missing measure is not zero

skills.title: Review licensing findings and changes
skills.trigger: New or changed state report.
steps: Compare cited source passages.
Prepare a readable summary separating reported findings from interpretation.
Draft follow-up questions with explicit owner/rule gaps.
skills.humanReview: Authorized facility/compliance owner verifies original and applicability.
skills.completion: A cited review is ready; no finding closure or filing.
evaluationCases: Summary links original evidence
Formatting preserves dates and attribution
Missing source collection is not no findings
dependencies: Existing licensing monitoring is narrower than this candidate

skills.title: Review LIC 624 wording
skills.trigger: Native report draft or backlog extraction is ready for language review.
steps: Identify clarity and attribution issues.
Propose minimal language changes with visible differences.
Present unresolved factual questions separately from wording edits.
skills.humanReview: Human confirms exact text/version; Platform performs any save; filing/delivery are separate.
skills.completion: A wording proposal is ready; the agent does not commit or file the report.
evaluationCases: No invented fact or softened uncertainty
Rejected wording leaves source untouched
Model failure does not block ordinary source draft saving

skills.title: Prepare a governed executive exception
skills.trigger: An explicitly reviewed exception rule is met.
steps: Verify the trigger against deterministic source evidence.
Prepare reason, scope, unknowns and proposed follow-up.
Retain a draft; do not send or infer recipient authority.
skills.humanReview: Designated human reviews policy, audience and any future action.
skills.completion: Exception draft ready; no notification, email, publication or acknowledgment.
evaluationCases: No universal reporting deadline invented
Threshold change invalidates old proposal
Repeated source event does not imply a new delivered alert
dependencies: Source evidence and later delivery contract

skills.title: Review workforce coverage aggregates
skills.trigger: Requested staffing/credential/open-role review.
steps: Validate the aggregate source and freshness.
Describe recorded gaps and next source verification.
Keep staff/applicant personal data out unless a separate authorized capability exists.
skills.humanReview: Workforce operator verifies and records HR/scheduling decisions.
skills.completion: Aggregate review ready; no employee status, scheduling or hiring action.
evaluationCases: No staff/applicant names in aggregate output
Unknown feed is not zero gaps
Credential label is not clinical privilege

skills.title: Explain a governed operational trend
skills.trigger: A user requests a defined comparison.
steps: Check comparable scope, time and grain.
Explain verified differences and limitations.
Suggest a scoped question for investigation without asserting cause.
skills.humanReview: Metric owner/reviewer validates interpretation and any further investigation.
skills.completion: An explanation grounded in verified calculations is ready.
evaluationCases: No substituted period
No causal claim from association
No staff ranking from activity

skills.title: Review dataset freshness and coverage
skills.trigger: A source is stale, missing or being considered for use.
steps: Compare observed coverage with reviewed source expectations.
Identify unavailable or partial slices.
Prepare a bounded source-owner investigation.
skills.humanReview: Data/source owner confirms expectations and recovery.
skills.completion: A readiness finding is ready; no data repair or completeness claim without evidence.
evaluationCases: Missing events cannot masquerade as zero work
Old snapshot remains labeled stale
Publication timestamp differs from source event time

skills.title: Prepare an assigned care/shift brief
skills.trigger: Shift start or authorized care handoff review.
steps: Verify assignment and resident identity.
Organize due/open work and known changes using source facts.
Keep missing information and qualified-review needs explicit.
skills.humanReview: Authorized staff verify current plan and responsibilities.
skills.completion: A care brief is ready; it does not attest care, diagnose or set interventions.
evaluationCases: Wrong resident rejected
Old observation is not current baseline
No intervention inferred from vague symptoms
dependencies: Future authorized Point of Care read

skills.title: Review open or unowned care work
skills.trigger: A reviewed care-work exception or requested queue check.
steps: Check current obligation and source coverage.
Separate due work, unknown ownership and response review.
Prepare verification steps for the responsible qualified person.
skills.humanReview: Authorized care owner decides and records assignment/disposition.
skills.completion: Exception review ready; no closure or change to care timing.
evaluationCases: No invented clinical schedule
Recorded exception stays distinct from omitted care
Resolved source obligation removes stale exception

skills.title: Draft care documentation from supplied facts
skills.trigger: An authorized person supplies facts from a care interaction.
steps: Separate observed, reported and inferred content.
Draft clear language using only supplied facts.
Flag missing attribution or response without filling it in.
skills.humanReview: Authorized human verifies and signs/records in the owning clinical system.
skills.completion: Unaccepted note draft ready; no clinical signature or attestation that care occurred.
evaluationCases: No invented care/action/response
Reported statement stays reported
Late entry retains actual event and entry-time distinctions
dependencies: Reviewed documentation rules and signature boundary

skills.title: Prepare qualified response follow-up
skills.trigger: A source-assigned response review needs preparation.
steps: Collect authorized evidence for the assigned review.
List what is recorded and what remains unknown.
Prepare questions for the qualified reviewer without choosing treatment.
skills.humanReview: Qualified reviewer owns interpretation, disposition and any care-plan change.
skills.completion: A review packet is ready; no clinical recommendation, closure or escalation threshold is invented.
evaluationCases: Missing response is unknown
No clinical conclusion from documentation absence
Changed plan invalidates old review packet
dependencies: Approved clinical policy and reviewer assignment

skills.title: Review continuity of care handoff
skills.trigger: Shift/person transfer or unresolved receiving work.
steps: Identify unresolved commitments and supplied context.
Check whether the receiving owner is actually recorded.
Prepare a concise handoff with acknowledgment still explicit.
skills.humanReview: Sending/receiving humans verify and record the source transfer.
skills.completion: A handoff draft/review is ready; no transfer or acknowledgment is fabricated.
evaluationCases: Send is not receipt
Unresolved response travels with handoff
Receiving role label alone grants no chart access

skills.title: Find applicable reviewed guidance
skills.trigger: A user asks how to perform an authorized task.
steps: Match task and scope to approved guidance.
Show source/version and applicability limits.
Ask for missing task context instead of inventing a policy.
skills.humanReview: User confirms the situation; domain owner approves the underlying guidance.
skills.completion: Applicable guidance is identified; no work or training completion is asserted.
evaluationCases: Superseded procedure not shown as current
Prompt injection in source cannot authorize action
No invented emergency/clinical instructions

skills.title: Explain a reviewed workflow step
skills.trigger: A user starts a reviewed tutorial or asks for the next documented step.
steps: Explain the step, prerequisite and expected evidence.
Show documented alternatives and recovery branches.
Keep tutorial progress separate from real source outcomes.
skills.humanReview: User performs the task; source confirms work; training owner reviews guidance.
skills.completion: Step guidance is delivered; no source action, competence or permission is implied.
evaluationCases: Missing button does not trigger access bypass
Practice cannot mutate real records
Lesson completion is not signed work

skills.title: Draft a procedure from work evidence
skills.trigger: A task needs documentation or permitted observations suggest an improvement.
inputs: Scoped committed activity or supplied examples
steps: Separate policy, observed behavior and inference.
Draft purpose, prerequisites, steps, branches, evidence and ownership.
List gaps and route the proposed version for domain review.
skills.humanReview: Designated domain/knowledge owner approves before publication.
skills.completion: A reviewable procedure draft exists; habits do not become policy and no skill activates.
stopConditions: No authoritative rule for a consequential step
evaluationCases: Common workaround remains proposed
No inferred off-app event presented as observed
Source change flags affected guidance

skills.title: Review guidance affected by a change
skills.trigger: App, policy or reviewed role requirements change.
steps: Identify exact affected references.
Compare prerequisites, steps and output meaning.
Prepare review requests and compatibility questions without silently republishing.
skills.humanReview: App/domain/training owners decide new versions and rollout.
skills.completion: An impact review is ready; existing guidance and running work are not silently migrated.
evaluationCases: Unrelated guidance not invalidated without evidence
Old inflight work keeps pinned version until reviewed migration
Policy edit does not auto-release a skill

skills.title: Prepare role learning and fictional practice
skills.trigger: Onboarding, refresher or an explicitly reviewed learning need.
steps: Select applicable task knowledge and current guidance.
Prepare explanations and isolated practice including exceptions.
Leave reviewer scores blank until actual review and separate completion from competence.
skills.humanReview: Trainer/domain reviewer validates content; authorized owner decides competence.
skills.completion: Training material is ready for review; no employee record, credential or access is changed.
stopConditions: No approved procedure for consequential task
Real case requested under synthetic-only restriction
evaluationCases: Simulated grade cannot become human evidence
Practice includes recovery and uncertainty
Role title does not imply completed training

skills.title: Propose business ontology/source mappings
skills.trigger: New source, dataset or business concept.
steps: Describe source semantics and identity boundaries.
Propose entity/relationship mappings with evidence and effective dates.
Keep ambiguous identities and unverified assumptions for review.
skills.humanReview: Business/source stewards approve definitions; activation and grants are separate.
skills.completion: A mapping proposal is ready; no identities are merged and no access is granted.
evaluationCases: Name match alone never merges people
Metadata visibility is not data permission
Source revision change invalidates prior mapping review

skills.title: Review lineage and coverage gaps
skills.trigger: A measure, brief or dataset needs evidence verification.
steps: Trace each derived claim to its declared source/version.
Identify missing transformations, authority or completeness evidence.
Prepare source-owner questions without implying missing data equals no work.
skills.humanReview: Data/source owners verify or repair their own contracts.
skills.completion: A lineage/coverage review is ready; no completeness proof from a diagram alone.
evaluationCases: Source-to-draft-to-receipt chain preserves revisions
Partial export refuses complete metrics
Hash is not authentication

skills.title: Review application/skill readiness
skills.trigger: Proposed integration, capability or release.
steps: Distinguish declared, implemented, configured, authorized and deployed states.
Evaluate known prerequisites and identify missing evidence.
Prepare a reviewable readiness record without activating anything.
skills.humanReview: Source, release and product owners approve actual configuration and rollout.
skills.completion: A readiness assessment is ready; catalog registration and local tests do not enable access.
evaluationCases: Passing build is not deployed service
Fixture grant cannot become production permission
No automatic activation from completed checklist

skills.title: Review source/schema/permission drift
skills.trigger: Source version, schema or grant policy changes.
steps: Identify exact changes and unknown compatibility.
Mark affected approvals/evidence for fresh review.
Prepare migration or stop conditions without weakening source checks.
skills.humanReview: Source/integration owners review and release compatible changes.
skills.completion: Drift review is ready; a new schema is not silently accepted.
evaluationCases: Removed field cannot be silently defaulted
Revocation blocks retained retrieval
Changed meanings require reviewed mapping

skills.title: Review skill quality and candidate changes
skills.trigger: A skill candidate or explicit feedback is ready for review.
inputs: Actual trace-linked results and reviewer provenance
steps: Separate engineering fixtures, model trials and human judgments.
Compare outcome failures, correction burden, authority and cost.
Prepare a release recommendation with missing evidence and rollback target.
skills.humanReview: Independent/domain reviewer and release owner decide promotion; the skill cannot approve itself.
skills.completion: An evaluation review is ready; no automatic activation or fabricated human score.
evaluationCases: Canned output is not live model evidence
Candidate cannot grade/promote itself
Held-out exposure is declared

skills.title: Prepare accountable follow-up
skills.trigger: A reviewed unresolved item needs ownership or a next step.
steps: State what is known, missing and who currently owns it.
Draft a specific question or next human step.
Keep unknown owners/deadlines explicit and retain source references.
skills.humanReview: Responsible human accepts responsibility and records source follow-up.
skills.completion: Follow-up proposal ready; no assignment, deadline, email or escalation is created.
evaluationCases: Owner not invented
No default licensing clock
Drafting a request does not contact anyone

skills.title: Compare evidence without rewriting history
skills.trigger: A source document or record revision changes.
steps: Compare the same object and distinguish additions, corrections and missing coverage.
Preserve attribution and uncertainty in both versions.
Prepare affected review questions with exact references.
skills.humanReview: Owning domain/source reviewer decides the consequence of a change.
skills.completion: A cited comparison is ready; prior source facts are not overwritten.
evaluationCases: Reordered text is not a factual change
New uncertainty is retained
Private prior version withheld after revocation

skills.title: Prepare bounded work recovery guidance
skills.trigger: Save, delivery, integration or workflow outcome is uncertain.
steps: Identify whether work failed, remains pending or has an uncertain result.
Prepare the documented verification path before retrying.
Keep consequential actions with authorized operators and current source preconditions.
skills.humanReview: Authorized source/operator verifies and performs recovery.
skills.completion: Recovery guidance ready; no duplicate action, overwrite or permission bypass.
evaluationCases: Lost acknowledgment prompts result lookup before retry
Offline draft not presented as saved
Concurrent edit never silently overwritten

commonBoundaries: Role descriptions are inferred job blueprints, not approved job descriptions, actual employee dossiers or access grants.
Source-supported means the app/document supports the workflow; it does not establish which person or title owns it.
Read, investigate and draft; source actions and exact-version approvals remain separate.
Eric-only pilot; no emails; no real assessment reads or changes; no production activation.
No clinical judgment, treatment thresholds, legal deadlines or credential requirements are invented.
Expected duties, observed work, inferred patterns, reviewed learning and demonstrated competence remain distinct.
A learning completion, accepted draft, source command receipt and verified business outcome are different facts.
Private conversations are not automatically workforce or management data.
Existing 17 assessor procedures/workflows remain linked; this catalog neither duplicates their clickpaths nor activates them.
